test_title: PYST 61: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215bdc67ee6bd89fd638fd9e9539bb67fc9e784ef19ced9aa887f8b33e83503c.png] 

Logic followed here is: The second letter-cluster in each pair is determined by subtracting 10 from the positional values of the letters in the first cluster.

1) MK – CA →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/808c3e223c9d958ac28ac1acce8e1e4addab1236e81230554ac7a2415e2e30cc.png] 

2) NK – DB →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0de21c9c05884ccc6618d153aac17d30114b6ecffeef6245505550baeb73367.png] 

3) AY – QO →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95a4b96f26a8806339c861f54c12fe1405d5f5ba8becbc8b9497960299ee2125.png] 

4) QO – GE →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b87dfca0a569a21a5e0bb1cfa1948257acf53435f1df38ea357d45745bfb5844.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
